main.description: Record indicating a livestream is published and available for replication at a given address. By convention, the record key is streamer::server

broadcaster.description: did of the broadcaster that operates the server syndicating the livestream

irohTicket.description: Iroh ticket that can be used to access the livestream from the server

moqURL.description: moqt:// URL of the Media over QUIC endpoint serving the livestream's MUXL segments; a certhash query parameter pins the server certificate (SHA-256, hex) when it is self-signed

server.description: did of the server that's currently rebroadcasting the livestream

streamer.description: DID of the streamer whose livestream is being published

updatedAt.description: Periodically updated timestamp when this origin last saw a livestream

websocketURL.description: URL of the websocket endpoint for the livestream
